ngspice-buck.review_note: Reviewed switching Buck reference solve path. Update only with an explicit model-review record; a changed digest means the numerical construction, execution, or parsing code changed. 0.5.1: the reviewed-identity module moved from pe_sim/backends/identity.py to pe_sim/identity.py and the adapters import it from the package root; digests were recomputed after that import-only change, no numerical code was modified. 0.5.2: the adapter now declares a class-level backend_id so the kernel can recompute its reviewed identity instead of trusting the self-reported record; the netlist template, solver settings, process invocation, and wrdata parsing are untouched. 0.13.0/0.13.1 (ADR 0004 step 2): the window netlist renders the PWM carrier delay as the time to the next absolute carrier start ((-phase) mod Tsw) instead of restarting at zero; a segment that starts inside an on-pulse renders the remaining on-time as a finite PWL tail summed with the periodic source, so the delivered energy is preserved; the constructor no longer requires the control period to be an integer multiple of the switching period; the hard NumericalLimit that stated that restriction is removed from the model claim; the adapter solves to the end of the current control window or the requested duration, whichever is longer, and a change point inside the window forces a re-solve because the inputs no longer match; the Runner ends a solve segment at the next external-input change point. Acceptance: tests/test_event_boundaries.py (D2 1.5x and 1.2x ratios vs one direct run; A4/D3 mid-window step in the off-phase and a 0.01% change in the on-phase vs an unchanged run; route declares continuous). Template version bumped to ngspice-buck-v2; Tsw, duty, device models, solver settings, process invocation, and wrdata parsing are otherwise untouched.

buck.review_note: Reviewed native averaged Buck reference solve path (reference_plants.py: averaged equations, RK4 integrator, analytical equilibrium). The run loop in runtime.py is intentionally outside this pin; the review covers the model implementation only, and the enclosure declares that boundary as an uncheckable rule. 0.5.1: the reviewed-identity module moved from pe_sim/backends/identity.py to pe_sim/identity.py and the adapters import it from the package root; digests were recomputed after that import-only change, no numerical code was modified.
